That is not entirely accurate. In Switzerland, the standard retirement age for men is 65 and for women is 64 (increasing to 65 gradually until 2024). However, you can request an **early retirement** from the age of 58 under certain conditions. However, the pension is reduced when taken early.

Conversely, you can also defer the AHV (Old Age and Survivors' Insurance) pension to receive a higher amount later. So, while 65 is the standard age for the full pension, early payment is indeed possible — but it comes with reduced benefits.
